Class GraphDoors

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.GraphDoors
final class GraphDoors extends Object
The class chooses the door for the engine word. The word pool opens the pool door. Any other word opens the Grok door.

  • Method Details

    • poolWord

      static boolean poolWord(String engineWord)
      The method reports whether the engine word is pool. The compare is lowercase after trim. A word that starts with pool/ is pool.
      Parameters:
      engineWord - The engine is the card's execution target.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the word is pool.

    • open

      static GraphDoor open(String engineWord, String user, boolean thinking, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink, Runnable end)
      The method opens the door for the engine word. The word pool returns a pool door that builds its chat on the first ask. Any other word returns the Grok door.
      Parameters:
      engineWord - The engine is the card's execution target.
      user - The user is the open SSH name.
      thinking - The flag is true when a thought ear is present.
      sink - The sink hears a reasoning chunk. The value may be null.
      end - The end closes the thinking block. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The door for this walk.

    • open

      static GraphDoor open(String engineWord, String user, boolean thinking, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink, Runnable end, PoolChat injected)
      The method opens the door and uses an injected pool chat. A null chat on the pool word throws on ask and does not build an engine. A Grok word ignores the injected chat.
      Parameters:
      engineWord - The engine is the card's execution target.
      user - The user is the open SSH name.
      thinking - The flag is true when a thought ear is present.
      sink - The sink hears a reasoning chunk. The value may be null.
      end - The end closes the thinking block. The value may be null.
      injected - The chat the pool door uses. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The door for this walk.

    • openSeated

      static GraphDoor openSeated(String engineWord, String user, boolean thinking, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink, Runnable end, GrokCallOptions options)
      The method opens the door and keeps the stored model options. A null options value leaves the Grok door on its own call options. The word pool still opens the pool door.
      Parameters:
      engineWord - The engine is the card's execution target.
      user - The user is the open SSH name.
      thinking - The flag is true when a thought ear is present.
      sink - The sink hears a reasoning chunk. The value may be null.
      end - The end closes the thinking block. The value may be null.
      options - The options are the stored model options. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The door for this walk.

    • supply

      static PoolChat supply()
      The method builds the pool chat on the first ask. The engine has metrics off. The chat is one PoolChatServer. A later call returns the same chat.
      Returns:
      The chat for a pool ask.

    • release

      static void release()
      The method shuts a chat that supply() built. A second call does nothing. The method does not throw.

    • grok

      private static GraphDoor grok(String engineWord, boolean thinking, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink, Runnable end)
      The method opens the Grok door. Thinking off leaves the call unstreamed.
      Parameters:
      engineWord - The engine is the card's execution target.
      thinking - The flag is true when a thought ear is present.
      sink - The sink hears a reasoning chunk. The value may be null.
      end - The end closes the thinking block. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The Grok door.

    • poolProperties

      private static CasseroleProperties poolProperties()
      The method reads casserole.pool from the classpath yaml. A missing block keeps the local child. The serve token is not written to a log.
      Returns:
      The return value is the properties the pool chat reads.
